description: Defines warning reporting categories classes for various timeout and resource issues in the Thunder WarningReporting namespace, including serialization, string conversion, and default bounds.

classes.name: TooLongWaitingForLock
classes.description: Represents a warning category for long wait times to acquire a lock.

classes.name: SinkStillHasReference
classes.description: Represents a warning category for sinks holding references during destruction.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeRPC
classes.description: Represents a warning for RPC calls that take too long.

classes.name: JobTooLongToFinish
classes.description: Warning for jobs that exceed maximum execution time.

classes.name: JobTooLongWaitingInQueue
classes.description: Warning for jobs waiting too long in queue.

classes.name: TooLongDecrypt
classes.description: Warning for decryption operations taking too long.

classes.name: JobActiveForTooLong
classes.description: Warning for jobs active beyond expected duration.

classes.name: SocketOperationTooLong
classes.description: Warning for socket operations exceeding time limits.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object state into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the object state from a byte buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the warning object to a string message.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes and sets interface and method IDs for RPC warning.
